cedar_policies.text: permit(principal, action, resource) when { action in [Action::"fs.read", Action::"git.read", Action::"process.exec", Action::"mcp.list", Action::"db.read"] };
forbid(principal, action, resource) when { action == Action::"secret.egress" };
forbid(principal, action, resource) when { action == Action::"git.force_push" && resource == Resource::"origin/main" };
